title: Dionysus reproached for the poor man's small plot
english: He had only a small plot of land, Dionysus, and he was holding on to the hopes that came from it, waiting to receive what the vines seemed ready to give. Why did you not come in abundance and show them heavy with fruit? If only you had stepped onto the wine vats and danced the Bacchic dance, and no part of the new wine had been left empty! From that he would have had wealth in fine measure, and he would have danced for pleasure and been more musical himself. Do you want to learn what Dionysus says to all this?

title: Wealth of words and wealth of money cannot coexist
english: "It is not possible," he says, "to be rich in words and in money at the same time. Therefore, paradoxical as it seems, I was withdrawing the grape clusters, so that I might cultivate his tongue more. For even the cicadas, feeding on dew alone, hold the Muses within themselves."

title: Cicadas, contentment, and song against tax collectors
english: They feed on dew alone, yet they contain the whole Muses within themselves. Hearing them, you would say that they were once human and have become cicadas.” So it is fitting to be content with present circumstances. And even if the tax collectors are troubling you, only sing to them, and they will immediately forget about the money.
